answer: Every claim climbs the pulse of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the knoll is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
